issues.display_title: Issue #398: Bug: "Show markers" visibility toggle doesn't hide point/safety markers
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Editor object-visibility bug.

Description

Unchecking Show markers in the object-visibility menu still leaves point/safety markers drawn on the canvas. Every other toggle (doors, windows, shapes, connections, room labels) hides its layer; markers don't.

Root cause

The "Show markers" toggle sets ctx.showIcons via setShow(ctx, "icons", …) (model-sync.ts:225), default true (index.ts:54). But the point/safety marker render block in draw.ts:316–~340 is a bare { … } scope with no ctx.showIcons gate — so markers are drawn unconditionally, unlike the gated doors/windows/shapes/links blocks.

Scope

  • Gate the point + safety marker draw block on ctx.showIcons (wrap the block in if (ctx.showIcons) { … }) in draw.ts.
  • Verify setShow("icons", …) triggers a redraw (it does via rebuild), so toggling updates the canvas immediately.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Unchecking "Show markers" hides all point + safety markers; re-checking shows them.
  • Other visibility toggles unaffected; default (checked) still shows markers.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Fixed in src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/draw.ts: the point/safety marker draw block was a bare { … } scope with no visibility gate. Wrapped it in if (ctx.showIcons), matching the doors/windows/shapes/links layers. setShow("icons", …) already triggers a redraw via rebuild, so toggling updates the canvas immediately.

  • Branch: feature/398-show-markers-toggle · Commit: 07f573f
  • tsc · eslint green. (Canvas draw layer — no unit-test harness; one-line guard on an existing flag.)

issues.display_title: Issue #394: Bug: linked Information name shown as subtitle in the editor object list
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Editor object list bug.

Description

In the editor object list, objects with a linked Information show that Information's name as a muted subtitle (e.g. "meja meeting", "ini info baru" under Point / Circle / Rectangle rows). Linked information should not be surfaced in the object list. Type subtitles must stay (door swing "Single/Double/None", safety type "Fire Exit", …).

Root cause

src/lib/editor/objectRows.ts rowSubtitle (L98–102): the else branch returns o.infoId ? resolveInfoName(o.infoId) : undefined — the linked Information name. Used by UnifiedObjectList (display) and buildObjectRows (search).

Scope

  • rowSubtitle: keep door swing + safety type; drop the linked-Information-name fallback (return undefined instead).
  • Remove the now-unused resolveInfoName / InfoNameResolver threading where it only fed the info-name subtitle (objectRows.ts, UnifiedObjectList.tsx, ObjectSection.tsx) — keep the diff clean, no unused params.
  • Editor object list only (no preview surface uses this).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Object rows no longer show linked Information names; door/safety type subtitles unchanged.
  • List, filters, counts, and object-name search still work.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Fixed in src/lib/editor/objectRows.ts: rowSubtitle no longer returns the linked Information name (keeps door swing + safety type). Removed the now-dead resolveInfoName / InfoNameResolver threading through buildObjectRows, UnifiedObjectList, and ObjectSection. Objects still carry infoId in the model (pano detection etc.) — only the list subtitle stopped showing it.

  • Files: objectRows.ts, panel/UnifiedObjectList.tsx, panel/ObjectSection.tsx, __tests__/objectRows.test.ts.

issues.display_title: Issue #388: Bug: selecting a door/wall after a room keeps the room selected (two selection toolbars stack)
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Editor selection bug.

Description

Select an area/room object, then click a different object type (e.g. a door/opening). The room selection is not cleared — both selection toolbars show at once: "1 selected" (opening: Size / Single·Double·None) and "1 room selected" (Height / Type). Should be single-category: picking a new type clears the previous selection.

Root cause

In src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/selection.ts:

  • toggleOp (L11–15) only resets ctx.selWalls.
  • toggleWall (L17–21) only resets ctx.selOps.

Neither clears selRooms, selManual, selShapes, or selAnnos — unlike selectRoom (L75), selectAnnotation (L97), and selectShape (L110), which all reset every other-category bucket to keep the one-category invariant. So selecting an opening/wall after a room (or shape/annotation) leaves the prior selection live, and both toolbars render.

Scope

  • In toggleOp and toggleWall, also reset the cross-category buckets (selRooms = [], selManual = -1, selShapes = [], selAnnos = []), matching the select* helpers — so a new opening/wall selection is category-exclusive.
  • Keep intra-category multi-select (Shift+click multiple openings/walls) working.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Selecting a door/window/wall after a room (or shape/annotation) clears the previous selection — only one selection toolbar shows at a time.
  • Shift+click still multi-selects within the same category.
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green.

RESULT

Root cause confirmed and fixed in src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/selection.ts.

toggleOp and toggleWall only reset their mutual bucket (walls ↔ openings); they now also clear selManual, selRooms, selAnnos, selShapes — matching the one-category invariant already enforced by selectRoom / selectShape / selectAnnotation. Selecting a door/window/wall after a room (or shape/annotation) now clears the prior selection, so only one selection toolbar shows. Intra-category Shift+multi-select is unchanged.

  • Files: src/lib/floorplanEditor/editor/selection.ts (toggleOp, toggleWall); tests added in __tests__/selection.test.ts (2 cases).
  • Branch: feature/388-selection-category-exclusive
  • Commit: 7a31765

issues.display_title: Issue #376: Wire the join-MapThru invite for unregistered emails to the backend
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Part of #350 (sprint) — functional pack for #349 [PRD] Update Collaborators, Roles, and Permissions. Design pack merged in #373.

Description

Item 7 of #350 (R9): inviting an address that has no MapThru account should offer to email them a join invite. The design pack shipped the full UI flow, but handleSendJoinInvite in src/components/editor/collab/ManageCollaboratorsDialog.tsx is a stub — it advances the panel straight to the "sent" state and the code carries an explicit warning: "WIRE IT before this reaches users, or nothing is actually sent."

Blocked by BE: needs a join-invite endpoint (invite this address to create a MapThru account, scoped to the project + role).

Scope

  • New server action calling the BE join-invite endpoint
  • handleSendJoinInvite calls it for real: join-invite-sending while in flight, join-invite-sent on success, a failure outcome on error (extend the invite state machine — today it has no join-invite failure state)
  • Remove the WIRE IT stub comment once wired

Acceptance Criteria

  • Sending a join invite hits the backend; "sent" only shows after a successful response
  • Failure shows an actionable error and returns the form to a retryable state
  • Invite state machine tests cover sending → sent and sending → failure
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

RESULT

Join-invite for unregistered emails wired to the real backend.

  • New joinInvite server action → POST /v1/projects/:id/members/join-invite. handleSendJoinInvite calls it for real: join-invite-sending → join-invite-sent (carrying email_sent) or a retryable failure. State machine now carries emailSent; a stored-but-unsent invite shows a non-blocking warning. WIRE-IT stub removed.
  • Note: BE folded the two-step behind POST /members (unknown email → 200 {registered:false}) + the dedicated join-invite endpoint, rather than one auto-send; FE adapted to that contract.
  • Files: actions/members.ts (joinInvite), components/editor/collab/ManageCollaboratorsDialog.tsx, lib/collaboration/invite.ts, components/collaboration/InviteCollaboratorForm.tsx, tests.
  • FE PR #378 (commit 2a48db0). BE join-invite endpoint: GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#115.

issues.display_title: Issue #375: Collaborator invite: surface the server's email-send outcome
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Part of #350 (sprint) — functional pack for #349 [PRD] Update Collaborators, Roles, and Permissions. Design pack merged in #373.

Description

Item 6 of #350 (R8): inviting an existing user should send them an email. Sending is the Go backend's job and does not exist yet; the FE currently shows "<email> was added as a <role> and has been emailed." — asserting an email that was never sent.

Blocked by BE: invite/add-member response must say whether the email was sent (or expose a failure).

Scope

  • ManageCollaboratorsDialog invite path: derive the success copy from the BE response — "added and emailed" only when the server confirms the send; "added (email could not be sent)" style fallback otherwise
  • Map any new BE error/response codes into classifyInviteFailure / invite state machine (src/lib/collaboration/invite.ts)
  • Adjust copy in the sent/failure states; no layout changes

Acceptance Criteria

  • Success toast/message never claims an email was sent unless the BE confirms it
  • Email-send failure after a successful add is shown as a non-blocking warning (member is still added)
  • Invite state machine tests updated for the new outcomes
  • pnpm test, pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit green

RESULT

Invite copy now derives from the server's real outcome.

  • BE sends the added-member email synchronously and returns email_sent; the success toast claims "…and has been emailed" only when email_sent is true, else "…we couldn't email them, but they now have access." Member is added either way (non-blocking).
  • classifyInviteFailure deleted — the server now signals outcomes explicitly (registered:false), so wording-guessing is dead code.
  • Files: actions/members.ts (InviteResult), components/editor/collab/ManageCollaboratorsDialog.tsx, lib/collaboration/invite.ts, __tests__/invite.test.ts.
  • FE PR #378 (commit 2a48db0). BE invite split + email_sent: GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#115.
  • tsc/lint/vitest green.
